verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal-services SaaS platform, so offering versioned public APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence pack describes only consumer-facing services: filings, registered agent, dashboard, and document storage. It contains no public API, no versioning scheme, and no deprecation policy. The llms.txt probe is crawler guidance, not a versioned API, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
